coordinate_frames.assembly_step: Two independent origins; winding-jig axis Y (forward -Y) and payoff axis Z.
coordinate_frames.print_step: Task 5 master geometry bounding-box-centered at the origin, then given the recorded release X/Y/Z rotations; the shaft uses an equivalent axis-parallel phase that places a planar face on the bed.
coordinate_frames.print_stl: The print STEP master translated vertically to minimum Z = 0 mm.
